name: Heat equation
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
    
  <RD format_version="1">
      
    <description>
        The <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heat_equation">heat equation</a>, also known as the diffusion equation, describes multiple phenomena including the spreading-out of heat in a solid body and the diffusion of chemicals in a liquid.
    </description>
    
    <rule type="formula" name="Heat equation" wrap="0">
      <param name="timestep"> 0.1 </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="1">
        delta_a = laplacian_a;
      </formula>
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
        <overlay chemical="a">
            <overwrite />
            <white_noise low="0.8" high="1" />
            <rectangle>
                <point3D x="0.2" y="0.3" z="0" />
                <point3D x="0.3" y="0.6" z="1" />
            </rectangle>
            <rectangle>
                <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0" />
                <point3D x="0.8" y="0.9" z="1" />
            </rectangle>
        </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
        <vertical_scale_2D value="40" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 127 0 63 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
